request: kick off add an important label to the app

spec.title: Add persisted important star to tasks
spec.summary: Add an 'important' flag to each task that users can toggle by clicking a star (★) next to the task title, similar to the existing done checkbox. The flag is persisted in the database (new `important` column on the tasks table) and survives page reloads and server restarts. No filtering, sorting, or additional styling is included — just the star toggle and its persisted state.
acceptance: Each task in the list shows a star control next to its title.
Clicking the star toggles the task's important state and the star visually reflects on/off state (e.g., filled vs. outline star or similar simple indicator).
Toggling the star persists the change via the API (new field on the task, saved to the database), and reloading the page shows the correct star state for every task.
Newly created tasks default to not important (star off/empty).
Existing task data (title, done state) is unaffected by this change.
The done checkbox and its behavior continue to work exactly as before.
unchanged: Task creation flow (title input + Add button) behaves the same.
Done checkbox toggle behavior and styling for completed tasks (.done class) is unchanged.
No filtering or sorting of tasks by important status is introduced.
No new pages, routes, or navigation are added.
API endpoints for listing and creating tasks keep their existing shape aside from the added `important` field.
spec.check: Load the app, add a new task, click its star to mark it important, reload the page and confirm the star remains on; click it again to unmark, reload and confirm it's off; verify the done checkbox still works independently of the star.
spec.reviewFocus: Confirm the `important` column is added via a migration/seed update, the PATCH endpoint accepts and persists the `important` boolean alongside `done`, the star toggle in app.js mirrors the existing checkbox toggle pattern, and no unrelated styling/filtering logic was introduced.

findings.note: toggleDone() and the checkbox in toListItem() show the pattern to mirror for a star toggle: create a control, wire a change/click listener that PATCHes the task and re-renders.
PATCH /api/tasks/:id currently only accepts `done` (boolean). Needs to also accept and persist `important` (boolean), similar to how `done` is handled.
tasks table schema (id, title, done) needs a new `important INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0` column; seed inserts should be updated accordingly.
No structural change expected here beyond what app.js renders into the existing #tasks list.
